template.source: TushyBidet · founder's coded swipe file (UVT = us vs them) · sorted F1 by sort-ad
template.production_method: collage — 2×2 photo grid (top row black-and-white 'with X', bottom row colour 'with Edenvia'), two rounded labels, a tweet card centred over the seam; photos by Seedream/gpt-image-2 (legs: body risk → seedream_comp), glass + tablet from the library, tweet card and labels by script

decode.scroll_stop_trick: A tweet floats over a grid where the top row is grey and gross and the bottom row is clean and colour: the proof is social and visual at once.
decode.hidden_reading: the peach is a bum; ours stays literal (ankle)
decode.scene_logic: four stills from her day. Ours top (B&W): a pile of 'detox' tea boxes; her swollen ankle at 5 pm. Bottom (colour): the tablet fizzing in a glass; the same ankle, slim, in a sandal
decode.visual_trick: the two rows show the SAME subject twice (peach dirty / peach clean) — ours: the same ankle twice, swollen in grey, slim in colour (same body, only the swelling changes)
decode.shape_or_function_equivalent: toilet rolls ↔ tea boxes and teabags; dirty peach ↔ swollen ankle (B&W); toilet ↔ glass with the fizzing tablet; clean peach ↔ slim ankle in colour
decode.render_style: top row desaturated photo, bottom row bright photo, white rounded labels top-right and bottom-right, white rounded tweet card with avatar, name, handle, counts
decode.text_treatment: labels bold sans black on white rounded tags; tweet in system sans

strategy.angle: A8-L heavy, swollen legs — the tea vs the tablet
strategy.mechanism: M1: when the body can't clear everyday oxidative stress, the tissue in the legs stays inflamed and stops draining normally, so fluid sits there — heavy, tender, puffy — and no diet reaches it, because it was never fat; the tablet turns a glass of water into hydrogen-rich water, hydrogen is the smallest molecule there is, reaches the tissue and helps the body switch that process off so normal drainage can resume
strategy.sub_avatar: trigger: the evening 'detox' tea ritual and the 5 pm ankle · cause: fluid held by inflamed tissue · tried: diuretic teas
strategy.belief_installed: It was never fat. It's fluid my body stopped clearing — and no diet reaches it.
